tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1)༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid skyer sgang lugs kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/// /

(2)༄༅// snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs dbang rā hu la// mnyam med jo bo nag tsho phyag sor ba// shes rab tshul khrims shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal// 'phags pa lce sgom rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grub mchog skyer sgang pa dang gnyan ston che// sangs rgyas ston pa shangs ston rgyal mtshan 'bum// byams dpal smon lam bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// shes rab bzang po rnams la= /gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs// chos grags rgyal mtshan nam mkha' dbang phyug dang*// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan kun dga' bsod nams dpal// bsod nams dbang phyug rnams la= /bsod nams mchog grub blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// dge 'dun don grub bstan 'dzin phrin las dpal// blo bzang chos 'dzin phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang*// blo bzang don grub rnams la= /ngag dbang blo bzang skal bzang thub bstan rje// blo bzang bstan 'dzin dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos bstan pa rab rgyas dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /sngon 'gro'i rim pas rang (3)rgyud legs sbyangs shing*/ sgo gsum lha sngags gnyug ma'i ye shes dang*// mkha' khyab stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab ba dge'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid skyer sgang lugs kyi ngag 'don snying por dril ba zung 'jug grub ster ces bya ba bzhugs so/// oṃ swa sti sidhaṃ// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// spyan ras gzigs la gus btud nas// gang dang dbyer med skyer sgang ba'i// thugs bcud zab don snying po 'dri// 'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben bar bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/

nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems sgom du ma nas yid la byed pas mtshams sbyar la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad legs pa'i lam ston bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha la= /sku gsum ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams la= /zab zhi spros bral dam chos rnams la= /sar gnas lam zhugs dge 'dun rnams la=(4)'gal rkyen kun sel srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus bya// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni// smon 'jug gi don dran bzhin pas/ deng nas bzung ste 'gro rnams sangs rgyas bar// rang nyid zhi bde skad cig med par ni// smon pa dang ni 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du// nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la bskul bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum/ bstun skyabs sems gnyis/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs brjod kyang rung*/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ dngos su bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal sgyur byas pa las rang gi lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa snod bcud kyi 'byor pa kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen por sprul te/ /sa gzhi spos chus byug cing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te 'bul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ /zhes ci nus dbul/ mthar tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim// bzhi pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/

lus gang*/ sdig sgrib dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par mos te/ gsal snang la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzla ba ci nus bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag /lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchod sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer mu med par 'phros pa'i gnas gsum yig 'bru (5)gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs te thim par bsam// yid kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod// mos gus kyi yid rtse gcig pas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus bskyar/ /mthar bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud brtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun bab/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur par mos la rang ngo bskyang*/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la skyabs sems rtsam gyi rjes dngos gzhi la 'jug kyang don grub pa yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis// mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin no// dang po ni/ /rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lte bar a dkar po/ de 'od du zhu lus kyi nang gang*/ 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/

bcud la thim/ de'ang rang la thim/ rang lus kyang mtha' nas dbus su yal bar mos te stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag la// oṃ swa bhā shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu hrīḥdamar po re re 'od du zhu ba las 'od zer dmar po'i drwa ba dang khor yug can gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te// de'ang dbus che ba/ g.yas g.yon gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar (6)ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo yi ge drug ma dkar mo yi ge zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/

pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o/ gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ya ā wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: nas / shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas dam tshig pa so so la thim par bsams la lha sku snang stong zung 'jug gi gsal snang phra rags la yun ring du sems bzung*/ de nas cung zad gom pa brtan pas snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par 'dod na rgyas par khrid yig las shes/ mdor bsdu na/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i skus zhing khams thams cad khyab cing*/ zhing khams (7)rab 'byams sku la rdzogs par gsal ba'i ba spu'i khung bu re re zhing yang dag pa'i zhing mtha' yas pa na dus gsum tshad snyed kyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bzhugs nas/ la las ni dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad/ la las ni phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos 'chad/ la las ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par rtse ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa rnams kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs shing de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas byung ste 'gro drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs/ kun kyang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku 'ba' zhig tu song nas yi ge drug ma'i sngags di ri ri bzla bar mos te rtse gcig pas dmigs pa'i ngang dang ma bral bar mnyam par 'jog /de ltar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang thon pa'am/

sgom pas skyon bzlas pa la 'jug ste// rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha steng 'og tu blta ba'i ltag sprod gyen lta'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa la rang nyid kyis bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang byung*/ don skye med kyi ngang du 'jog bzhin du yi ge drug pa ci nus su bgrang mthar/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od du zhu/ ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul gyis spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par bsam/ slar yang sngags phreng sngar lhar gsal btab cing bzlas pa dang 'od du zhu ba'i dmigs pa spel ma ji tsam nus pa bya/ mthar gong du bshad pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus bya ste/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng pad+ma'i gdan la thim/ de sa bon hrīḥl thim par bsam/ gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can la phog /de 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /de dag 'od du zhu/ mtha' nas 'dus te 'khor(8)gnyis la thim/ de gnyis rang la thim/ rang nyid yas mar nas zhu/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim de'ang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsams la/ gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i dbyings su blo lhod kyis glod de ci tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag /gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*/ dang po ni/ thun de las ldang ba na// slar yang rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur par bsams la/

dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te/ thun mtshams rnams su/ gnas gzhal yas khang*/ zas ye shes kyi bdud brtsi/ gos lha rdzas kyi na bzar bsams la zhen pa med par longs spyod/ snang grags rtog gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi lam khyer dang*/ byang chub sems gnyis kyi rtsis zin par spyod lam dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ khyad par bde stong*/ thun mong byang sems/ lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor rnams te/ bsgom par 'dod na khrid yig tu shes/ bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas yi ge drug pa 'bum phrag so gnyis sam/ tha ma'ang 'bum phrag bdun bzla ba grangs bsnyen/ zla ba gsum nas zla ba gcig gi bar du bsnyen/ rab dngos sam/ 'bring nyams su 'phags pa'i sku mthong ba/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra thob pa/ tha ma'ang rmi lam du de lta bu'i rim pa rmi ba dang*/ gzhan yang khrus byas pa/ gos dkar gon pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ me tog dkar po 'thub/ shel dkar gyi phreng ba rnyed pa sogs dge ba'i rtags ci rigs pa mthong ba ni mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o// 'jam dbyangs la sogs phyogs bcu yi// 'phags rnams dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen che/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po skyer sgang pa'i// thugs bcud snying po'i man ngag go /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid skyer sgang lugs kyi ngag 'don snying por dril ba'i le'u tshan no// ༈ //maṅga lam// ༈ //thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi khrid yig bzhugs so/// /(9)oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ// snyigs ma ldan pa'i zhing spyi dang*// khyad par gangs ri'i mgon gcig pu// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag der btud nas// de yi rnal 'byor 'dus gsal spel// gnyis pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i man ngag grub thob skyer sgang pa'i bka' srol dang 'brel pa spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/

dang po sngon 'gro la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ thun mong ba thub pa'i lta khrid ltar 'chad/ thun mong ma yin pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni// dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi ljon shing rtse mo lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bla ma spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal gar spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi yal gar sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dkon mchog pusti'i rnam pa/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ bar mtshams rnams su mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs ma lus pa bzhugs par mos la/ rang dang sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig rgyas pa/ bdag dang sems can thams cad legs pa'i lam ston bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha la= /sku gsum ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams la= /zab zhi spros bral dam chos rnams la= /sar gnas lam zhugs dge 'dun rnams la= /'gal rkyen kun sel srung ma rnams la=

zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan brgya stong du bsags/ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni// sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can (10)thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lam gyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ deng nas bzung ste 'gro rnams sangs rgyas bar// rang nyid zhi bde skad cig med par ni// smon pa dang ni 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du// nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la bskul bar bgyi// zhes sam bsdu na/ bdag gis sbyin sogs brjod/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni// lag len ltar legs par bshams te/ rgyas par na chos chung brgya rtsa las 'byung ba dze tā ri dang gnyis med rdo rje'i go cha la sogs pa ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na tshom bu so bdun ma nas/ bdun ma'i bar dngos su bshams pa de nyid rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur dmigs pa lan grangs mang por phul bas bdag gzhan gyi tshogs rdzogs/ sku las 'od zer byung sdig sgrib dag /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ slar yang mos gus kyi rkyen gyis skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par mos// bzhi pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni// stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par mos te gsal snang la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzla ba ci nus bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag /lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni// rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar/ zhabs sems skyil/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa 'od zer mu med par (11)'phro ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs te thim par bsam/ yid kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ mos gus kyi yid rtse gcig pas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus bskyar/ mthar bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun bab/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur par mos la rang ngo bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshan bcas lha bsgom pa dang*/ mtshan med de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi rnal 'byor ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun nam rang lugs kyi skyil krung sogs mdor na bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod/ rlung ched du stsol ba med bar rang babs su bzhag /sems g.yo med dngas gsal gyi ngang la gnas/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rten srung 'khor bsgom pa/ brten pa lha bsgom pa/ lha'i gsal snang 'don pa/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mal gyi phyogs bzhir hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen bstan re re/ steng 'og gnyis su hrīḥdamar mgo gyen dang mthur bstan re gsal/ mdun gyi hrīḥ'od kyi mig mang ris su yol ba lta bur zhu/ de las 'od zer g.yas kyi hrī la phog

/de'ang sngar ltar zhu/ de'i 'od nub/ de'i 'od g.yon du 'phog pas hrīḥzhu ba sogs sngar ltar dang*/ steng 'og gi hrīḥyang 'od du zhu/ 'gebs pa dang sa (12)gzhi'i rnam par gyur te/ 'od zer gyi drwa ba dang khor yug can gyi gzhal yas khang bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar pa'i phyi rol tu me ri rtse mo kha dog sna lnga pa can gyi gur khang gsal la brtan pa yun ring du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lte bar a dkar po/ de 'od du zhu lus kyi nang gang 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/ bcud la thim/ de'ang rang la thim/ rang lus kyang mtha' nas dbus su yal par mos te stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de'ang dbus che g.yas g.yon gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur ba las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/

g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu (13)gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo bo yi ge drug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ke te shwa ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā:hūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas dam tshigs pa so so la thim par bsam// gsum pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i lha la gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom tshul lo// dang po ni// de ltar gsal ba'i lha sku'i snang ba lam me ba de la sems bzung*/ de'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngang res 'ga' gdan nas gtsug tor bar/ res gtsug tor nas gdan gyi bar/ res spyan gyi dkar nag lta bu phra ba nas rags pa'i bar res rags pa phyag zhabs nas phra ba spyan gyi bar gsal btab/ de dag brtan nas lhar snang spyi la sems gtad de mthar ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad ma 'dres par shin tu gsal zhing blo rtse gcig pa la brten pa thob par bya ste dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni// rang nyid pad zla'i steng na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku yis zhing khams thams cad du khyab cing zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho sku la rdzogs par lam gyis gsal ba'i sku lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nyi ma'i 'od ces pa na/

byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig du ma dang*/ gser gyi ri khri re re la'ang rtse mo khri nyis stong*/ rin po che'i khang bzang skyed tshal rgyan bkod du mas (14)brgyan pa yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrogs pa/ ba spu de'i nang na yang rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ lha'i gser gyi ri brgyad rin po che'i brag ri ljon shing dag dang zas gos lha'i rang bzhin las grub pa la byang chub sems dpa' dag longs spyod cing*/ yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog go /ba spu de 'das pa na sman chen po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' bskyed ma thag pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong*/ rdo rje dngul/ gser/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga /margad/ shel gyi ri rtse mo brgyad khri yod pa/ dri za'i sil snyan gyi sgra las yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi dbyangs 'byin cing*/ gang sems thog ma bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa sems te/ kye ma'o sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi sems la skyo ba'i skyil mo krung bcas te lus drang por bsrangs nas dran pa mngon par bzhag nas ri de dag la 'khod do// ba spu de yang 'das pa na/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du ma me 'bar ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po brgya phrag stong dag la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam sdong po/ rtsa ba mu tig /lo ma gser dngul/ me tog man shel las byas pa dag las rgyan cha du ma dang ka shi ka'i gos rnams 'phyang ngo*// de 'dra ba'i ri rnams la rang sangs rgyas dag bzhugs nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgrar ston no// thams cad kyi tha ma na ba spu'i khung bu rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po na/

rin po che'i ri brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ dpag bsam dang tsan+dan dang bye ru'i shing de snyed yod cing rin chen 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling du mngon par phyogs shing chos 'chad pa/ phar phyin drug yi ge 'bru drug tu ston par mdzad pa yang (15)bzhugs pa sogs/ mdor na/ skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs nas la las ni dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba mdzad/ la las ni phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos 'chad/ la las ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par rtse ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa thams cad kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs zhing de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas byung ste// 'gro drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs/ kun kyang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku 'ba' zhig tu song nas yi ge drug ma'i sngags di ri ri bzla bar mos te rtse gcig dmigs pa'i ngang dang ma bral bar mnyam par 'jog go /bzhi pa ni// de ltar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang thon pa'am/ sgom pas skyon bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha steng 'og tu lta ba'i ltag sprod/ gyen lta'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la rang nyid kyis bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang byung*/ don skye med kyi ngang du 'jog bzhin du yi ge drug pa ci nus su bgrang mthar/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od du zhu/ ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul gyis spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar bsam// slar yang sngags phreng sngar ltar gsal btab cing bzlas pa dang 'od du zhu ba'i dmigs pa spel ma ji tsam nus pa bya/

mthar gong du bshad pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe yi ge rnams pad+ma ltag sprod la thim (16)de hrīḥl thim par mos// gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can la phog te 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /de dag 'od du zhu/ mtha' nas 'dus te 'khor gnyis la thim/ de gnyis rang la thim/ de nyid yas mar nas zhu/ thugs ka'i hrī la thim/ de'ang 'a chung ra la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo// mgo bo gi gu/ de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag /mi gnas par 'phro bar tsam brtsam pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las thim le gsum/ de'i dbus la hrīḥ de las gtso 'khor gsum/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha'i rang bzhin du mos/ 'di la ched du sbyangs nas/ slar bsdu zhing mnyam par 'jog ste lhar ldangs pa sogs sngar ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor dngos dang*/ zhar byung gi rnal 'byor gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sgom bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor grub nas/ rjes spyod lam la 'jug pa na 'khor gnyis rang la thim/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis kha zas thams cad 'bru gsum gyis ye shes bdud brtsir byin gyis brlabs te rang lhar gsal bas longs spyad/ gos lha'i gos pañca li kā ra bsams te tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag tu spyad/ 'gro 'dug sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig tu mos la bsngo smon rgyas par bya ba sogs theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung gi rnal 'byor la gsum/ khyad par bde stong gi rnal 'byor thun mong byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ rang jo bor gsal/ mdun du lha mo yi ge drug drug ma bsgom/ de'i smin mtshams su thig le dmar ba/

de las 'od zer dmar po che ba'i dad ldan byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams (17)su phog /rang gi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dkar po bde ba'i ngad ldan byung*/ lha mo'i lte bar phog /'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pas sku lus nang nas yar song slar smin mtshams su nas 'od dmar po rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa sogs 'khor lo ltar bsgom pas yab yum gnyis kar bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsams la/ bde ba ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom zhing bde ba skyes na stong pa bsre/ stong nyams kyi bde ba yal na slar 'od 'khor bsgoms la bde ba bskul/ mthar stong pas rgyas gdab/ 'di bya rgyud rang lugs kyi thabs lam dod bltas pa'i bde ba lam khyer gyi rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa ni/ dang po rang gi mdun du rtsa ba'i ma de bsam/ ma 'dis bdag gi lus srog bskyed pa nas bzung*/ tshe rabs thams cad du phan pa tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa'i drin re che snyam du bsams la byams pa tshad med pa bsgom/ ma 'di thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig la spyod cing thar dus ye med pa snying re rje snyam du snying rje tshad med pa bsgom/ ma 'di bdag kho nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la nges par 'god par bya'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa bsgom/ de la 'byongs na dgra dgegs dang*/ sems can mtha' yas pa la mtshungs par bya'o// gsum pa la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun nye ring mtshams par thugs rje chen po'i sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yid chags pa bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du mchod pa bsham/ de thugs rje chen po dngos su gsal la mchod bstod bya/ bdag la re sa khyed las med do snyam pa'i blo gtad ling bskyur byas la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so/

(18)rnam shes bde chen du 'pho bar byin gyi brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba lan mang du btab/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar por gyur ba sna bug g.yas nas rgyangs kyis thon/ jo bo'i shangs bug g.yas nas thugs kar zhugs par mos la der sems 'dzin/ slar shangs bug g.yon nas byung*/ sna bug g.yon nas snying khar zhugs/ yang sna bug g.yas nas 'phangs pa sogs 'khor mar spyad/ mthar thun 'jog pa'i tshe hūm̐ rang gi snying khar thim pa'i rjes jo bo rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba btab pas jo bo 'od du zhu/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rang lus bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang bas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang*/ rgas pa med pa'i lang tsho dang ldan par mos la bsngo smon bya// gnyis pa ni/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe nyer bsdogs sngar ltar byas la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i rigs la bshags sdom yid tshim bar byas/ lus longs spyod maṇ+ḍal du phul te zhen 'khris rbad kyis bcad la chags zhen dang blo ma bde ba spu tsam med par bya/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar po sna bug g.yas nas thon pa sogs sbyong ba'i skabs ltar la/ jo bo'i thugs kar thim tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhag /slar rnam shes chur 'thon pa'i dmigs pa mi bya bar yang yang 'phang*/ des kyang 'pho ma nus na rang lus kyang 'od du yal te jo bo'i thugs kar sib kyis thim par mos te sems rtog med du bzhag pas/ rab 'od gsal du grol 'bring tha ma lha dang mi'i skye/ 'ja' 'od dang ring bsrel sogs ltas bzang po 'byung bar bshad do/ khrid 'di stan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i tshe mtshan bcas rnal 'byor gyi skabs thog mar snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ slar srung 'khor dang lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa byas na lag len bde zhing don dang mi 'byor ba med do (19)gsungs// dal 'byor yon tan brgya ldan lus// snying po len 'dod skal bzang dag
/ma nor lam mchog 'dir zhugs shig /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho myur thob 'gyur// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid kyi le'u tshan no/// /(20)
